faqs.q: Is Indian Oil Axis Bank Credit Card the best Indian Oil co-branded credit card in India?
faqs.a: Indian Oil offers co-branded credit cards with Axis Bank, HDFC Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank and RBL Bank. Among all its co-branded cards, Indian Oil RBL XTRA Credit Card comes with the highest saving potential, albeit at a comparatively higher annual fee of Rs. 1,500.

faqs.q: How many EDGE Reward Points can I earn in a month through Axis Indian Oil Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can earn maximum 1,000 EDGE Reward Points on Indian Oil Fuel Spends and maximum 250 reward points on online shopping. There is no limit on reward earnings across other eligible categories.

faqs.q: How can I redeem the EDGE Reward Points earned through this card?
faqs.a: EDGE Reward Points can be redeemed through Axis Bank’s EDGE Reward Portal against vouchers and merchandise.

faqs.q: How much discount can I avail on BookMyShow through this card?
faqs.a: Maximum discount on movie ticket booking via BookMyShow is capped at Rs. 100 per month.

faqs.q: Which transactions are excluded from rewards program?
faqs.a: Spends made on rent, wallet, insurance, EMI, cash withdrawals, fee & charges, GST and payment reversals are not eligible for spend-based fee waiver.

faqs.question: Is the IndianOil Axis Bank Credit Card worth it?
faqs.answer: The card can be worth considering if you regularly refuel at IndianOil outlets and spend up to ₹5000 per month on fuel. However, the ₹3.5 lakh annual fee waiver requirement makes it less attractive than before.

faqs.question: What is the reward rate on the IndianOil Axis Bank Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The card offers 4% value back on eligible fuel spends at IndianOil outlets, 1% on online purchases, and 0.2% on most other eligible transactions.

faqs.question: What is the annual fee for the IndianOil Axis Bank Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The card charges a joining fee and annual fee of ₹500 plus GST. The annual fee is waived on spending ₹3.5 lakh in a card anniversary year.

faqs.question: Does the IndianOil Axis Bank Credit Card offer fuel surcharge waiver?
faqs.answer: Yes. The card offers a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on eligible fuel transactions between ₹400 and ₹4,000, subject to a maximum waiver of ₹50 per statement cycle.

faqs.question: Can I use the IndianOil Axis Bank Credit Card for UPI payments?
faqs.answer: Yes. The card is issued on the RuPay network and can be linked with supported UPI apps for eligible transactions.
